package.description: Applies machine learning models to detect and classify sounds in audio data.

en-US.description: Applies machine learning models to detect and classify sounds in audio data.
en-US.longDescription: Raven Intelligence is a free tool that applies machine learning models to audio data. It automates sound detection and classification and can train new sound detector-classifiers using TensorFlow, PyTorch, and ONNX models.
en-US.name: Raven Intelligence

zh-CN.description: 使用机器学习模型检测和分类音频数据中的声音。
zh-CN.longDescription: Raven Intelligence 是一款将机器学习模型应用于音频数据的免费工具。它可自动检测和分类声音，并可使用 TensorFlow、PyTorch 和 ONNX 模型训练新的声音检测与分类器。
